name: Community Tasks
description: Provides a 'Community task' node type with a three-state workflow (open → committed → completed): an admin posts an open task, a permitted user commits to it (becoming the responsible owner), an admin marks it completed, and each user's completed-task count and current commitments are shown on their profile. Ships a bundled Views listing at /community-tasks.
project_description:
Post tasks and have users commit to doing them. Then mark the task completed. This module creates a node type and uses the uid and promote flag to make a 3 stage workflow.

Full views integration.
